tasks.title: Authenticate UI, API, and stream with a per-launch token
acceptance: Requests without the token are rejected
Token never reaches logs or agent-visible artifacts
The Electron app passes the token to its window at launch; the API picks a random free port

notes.text: Prioritised for the Electron plan (docs/architecture/ELECTRON_PLAN.md): today any local program can call the API; host and origin checks only stop web pages.

Every API request, the app and run event streams, uploads and the terminal socket require X-Spark-Token (401 otherwise, SHA-256 + timingSafeEqual); host/origin checks stay first. Launchers pass SPARK_API_TOKEN (removed from the API env); pnpm dev writes .local/api-token (0600) and the Vite proxy injects the header, so the browser never holds it. Agents are denied api-token files. Evidence: unit 158 files/1182 tests, db 53/306 on spark_outpost_test_token, browser --workers=1 170 passed / 5 axe/titles timeouts that passed on rerun (31/31 incl. launch-token spec). Random port and Electron injection remain for the Electron work.

tasks.title: Embedded terminal for CLI install and login
acceptance: Opens only after a failed CLI check, with the install command typed in but not run
Killed with its whole process tree on close, disconnect, shell exit, 10 min idle, 30 min cap, and server shutdown
Single-use token, required allowed origin, secrets stripped from the shell environment
Help hints for npm missing, npm permissions, install success, CLI not found

notes.text: 16 terminal unit tests, including a check that the close test fails if only the shell is killed; 7 browser tests; no leftover shells after runs. Not yet checked: a real npm install and claude login in the terminal (the user's run).

Follows omnigent's xterm.js patterns (Apache-2.0; reimplemented, nothing copied): fit, web-links (http/https only, noopener), WebGL with fallback and context-loss handling, OSC 52 clipboard writes blocked, binary I/O with server-side batching, resize dedupe, StrictMode-safe start, Mac line-editing keys, contrast 4.5 and white remapped on light themes. Differs on purpose: no reconnect, because the terminal is killed on disconnect. check 56 unit, test:db 27, test:browser 7 pass, no leftover shells.

Smart flow: verification reports cli_missing or not_logged_in and the terminal starts on the matching step (install or claude auth login). Terminal closes and checks again by itself after a clean install or a successful login. Claude login verified for free with claude auth status (the test request is only a fallback). Parent Claude Code env vars stripped. Browser tests are hermetic (fake codex CLI, no host PATH). check 60, test:db 29, test:browser 7 pass.
